label: Catholicism is true: the Catholic Church is a teaching authority…, by Existential and conjunction…

meaning: Root route with the sense of 'necessary' as a parameter of the necessary root: the root necessary in the one intended sense, with the seven stage 3-6 premises, gives Catholicism (phase 1) through the unchanged skeleton. Only the root facts (God, the one God, classical attributes) are consumed in this step; the necessity sense is carried by the premise node, so the conclusion follows on whichever enumerated reading is intended.
